title: Protasis would the contraction for such several schemes become a natural and necessary apodosis
html_source:
Protasis: In logic and grammar, the antecedent in a conditional sentence.

Apodosis: The consequential clause in a conditional sentence.

In “I will be coming if this weather holds up”, “this weather holds up” is the protasis and “I will be coming” is the apodosis.
